name: Cognitive Load Threshold Boundary Condition
fact: Under high task difficulty, verbose emotional scaffolding in AI systems can exceed a learner's working memory capacity, acting as an extraneous processing burden rather than affective support.

provenance.title: Not a universal benefit: Examining the differential effects of emotional <scp>AI</scp> on <scp>L2</scp> pre‐service teachers' language learning
provenance.quote_or_locus: It identifies a cognitive load threshold boundary condition: under high task difficulty, verbose emotional scaffolding may exceed learners' working' memory capacity and act as an extraneous processing burden rather than affective support
